description: Selected from 3,000+ applicants for a year-long AI/ML fellowship. Built end-to-end machine learning pipelines on datasets of 50K+ records, achieving 85% classification accuracy using scikit-learn and TensorFlow while strengthening foundations in neural networks and responsible AI.

Collaborated with designers, engineers, and nonprofit stakeholders to build a mobile-first marketplace MVP. Translated product requirements into production-ready frontend features using Next.js and REST APIs while communicating technical tradeoffs to ensure alignment across technical and non-technical teams.

Built core frontend features for the brand dashboard using Next.js and REST APIs, enabling brands to manage profiles and partnerships seamlessly. Designed the student-side PostgreSQL schema to support profiles, applications, and scholarship data at scale.
